name: feature-coordinator
description: Marketplace for feature-coordinator: local-first multi-repo feature coordination on any git host

plugins.name: feature-coordinator
plugins.description: Local-first coordination of one feature across many git repositories on any host - GitHub, Azure DevOps, GitLab, Bitbucket, Gerrit, Gitea, self-hosted or local: a coordinator session plus one worker session per repo worktree, locked contracts, triaged reviews, visible decisions.
